idea.description: the one idea in one sentence

hook.description: what is on frame 1 and why it stops the scroll

wow.description: the one moment nobody has seen in a template

frame.description: ONLY when the piece is built on the person's video: how it sits in this shot — full | card | split | corner | away | over; otherwise empty

pictures.description: 0–4 PICTURES SHOWN INSIDE the motion that nobody gave (a product photo, an object, a person or character, an illustration that appears as a picture in a shot). GPT Image 2 makes each one WITHOUT any writing. The motion itself and its whole foundation are CODE, always: never ask for a background, a backdrop, a texture, a world, a frame, type, shapes, particles or a transition — you draw all of that. Usually [].

prompt.description: English, detailed: subject, style matching the palette, lighting, composition, empty space where your type goes; never any text

use.description: where and how the scene uses it

music.description: the music bed in words (mood, tempo, instruments), or empty

narration.description: only when the person records their own voice: the lines they will read, in order, with the seconds planned for each; otherwise []

skillRefs.description: ids from <skill-catalogue> to have open, word for word, while writing and reviewing this piece (≤ 12)

say.description: to the person, in Gulf Arabic, 1–2 sentences: the idea and why it will stop the scroll

notes.description: to the person, Gulf Arabic, one sentence on what you built or fixed

hook.description: Hook: something striking already moving in frame 1; the idea readable by ~1.5 s; no lead-in, no logo intro

concept.description: One clear concept a viewer can say in one sentence; every shot serves it

hero.description: One hero per frame, an obvious focal point, ≥ 40% of the frame breathing during holds

motion.description: Easing quality: strong ease-out in, ease-in out, springs (no linear starts/stops), overshoot inside budget, arcs, follow-through, staggers that read as one gesture

camera.description: Camera life and depth: a slow push or parallax on every hold, ≥ 3 depth planes, no dead locked-off frames

light.description: Light and finish: a motivated glow/rim, a moving specular or sweep, restrained bloom, grain, vignette, no banding, no clipped highlights

type.description: Typography: ≤ 2 families, weight and size contrast, one idea ≤ 7 words per card, held ≥ 1.5 s, inside the safe zone, readable on a phone; Arabic whole words, right to left

color.description: Colour discipline: 3–5 colours, ONE accent used sparingly, near-black / off-white instead of pure #000/#fff

variety.description: Something new every 0.8–2 s; no two beats arrive the same way; transitions motivated (a shape carries into the next shot), never preset wipes

sound.description: Sound (read the program's sound() and cues against the frames — you cannot hear it): whoosh peaking on the move, impact on the landing frame, riser cresting on the reveal; ~1 accent per 1–2 s; not on every move; with a voice, the big accents in the gaps between lines and the visuals landing on the words

wow.description: The million-dollar test: would a viewer believe a top studio was paid for it? At least one moment nobody has seen in a template

clean.description: Technically clean: no overlap of texts, no pops or flicker, nothing cut by the frame, a held ending (≥ 2 s) or a seamless loop

verdict.description: to the person, Gulf Arabic, 1–2 sentences: what you saw and what you changed

code.description: the COMPLETE revised program when any score is below 8; empty when every score is ≥ 8

reply.description: to the person, Gulf Arabic, short (1–3 sentences): what you understood and what you are doing, or the answer / the one question

action.description: none = only talk; plan = (re)write the scenario from `brief`; code = the COMPLETE revised program in `code`; cover = design the piece's cover now; render = make the final film now

options.description: 0–4 short replies the person can press next (Gulf Arabic, 2–5 words each, e.g. «اعتمد وابنِ»، «أسرع شوي»، «صمّم الكفر»); [] when nothing obvious

brief.description: action plan: the complete creative brief from the whole conversation (the idea, length, tone, every word to show, colours, what to avoid); else empty

code.description: action code: the COMPLETE revised scene program (it replaces the old one); else empty

search.description: a web search to run FIRST, when the person asks you to look something up («ابحث»، «وش الترند») or your answer needs facts you don't have (a number, a brand's look, what is viral now) and no WEB RESEARCH is given yet: the query in a few words (action is then "none" and reply says you are searching); else empty

headline.description: the cover's headline exactly as drawn (≤ 5 words), from the film's own words

code.description: the complete cover program (scene({ duration: 1, draw(K, t, ctx) { … } }))

notes.description: to the person, Gulf Arabic, one sentence: the idea of the cover

read.description: At the profile grid's size (the 12 % picture) the headline is read at a glance; nothing important is under the skill's minimum sizes (headline ≥ 170 px, any other text ≥ 110 px, logos ≥ 200 px, lines ≥ 10 px)

square.description: Everything that must be seen (face, headline, logos) sits inside the centre 1:1 square (portrait y 420–1500); outside it only background; it survives the 1:1, 4:5 and 3:4 crops

hook.description: The headline is the film's own hook in ≤ 5 words, two lines at most (≈ 9 letters a line at 170 px) — never words the film does not say

face.description: The person (from the film's own frames) is big and clear, never redrawn, never covered by a word; chin above the headline, the body cut at the chest

contrast.description: Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (3:1 only for the huge headline), bold weights only, no letter-spacing on Arabic, no @handle

brand.description: The film's own palette and fonts (one accent), so the cover belongs to the piece and to the brand

finish.description: A designer's finish: one clear idea, depth, nothing cheap (no clutter, no stock glow, no centred-title-on-gradient)

problems.description: what is wrong, most important first (≤ 4)

verdict.description: to the person, Gulf Arabic, one sentence: how it reads and what you changed

code.description: the COMPLETE revised cover program when any score is below 8; empty otherwise
